title: Unlock POWER LEVEL 8 Gear FAST in RuneScape Dragonwilds – Full Armor & Weapon Guide!
author: RuneScape Universe
description:
Want to unlock Power Level 8 gear in RuneScape: Dragonwilds? In this complete Scorned Wilderness crafting guide, I'll show you how to obtain all the materials, unlock the recipes, and craft the new Power Level 8 melee, ranged, and mage weapons and armour!

Icthlarin’s Little Helper Quest Guide - https://youtu.be/CGKbJnASBwc

Scorned Wilderness Full Raid Walkthrough - TBC

Regicide Quest Guide (Raid without gathering resources) - https://youtu.be/osZKPmm848U

Thanks for watching! 🎮
Subscribe for more RuneScape Dragonwilds and OSRS adventures.

#RuneScape #RuneScapeUniverse #Dragonwilds #OSRS #RuneScapeGuides #DragonwildsGameplay #RuneScapeChallenges #RuneScapeTutorials

transcript.text: Hey guys, in this quick tutorial, I'll show you how to obtain power level eight gear in Runescape Dragon Wilds. First,
you'll need to unlock the Scorned Wilderness region by completing the Actclar Little Helper quest. As always,
you can find my full quest walkthrough linked in the video description. All the materials required for power level 8
gear can be found within the Scornet Wilderness raid. So, before entering, make sure you're properly prepared and
have everything you need in your inventory and personal chest. Before we move into the raid, let's quickly check
the inventory and what I'm bringing with me. As you can see, I'm still power level 7 and have only just arrived in
this region, so I can't use any of the new power level 8 equipment yet. For combat, I'm bringing two different melee
weapons, giving me both slash and crush damage depending on what we are fighting. I've also got a wand for quick
magic damage and a bow just in case we need some range. For food, I'm using glazed pumpkin sandwiches. They reduce
the energy used while mining, which is useful because I'll be collecting new resources along the way. They also give
a 10% XP boost to all skills and restore health over time. So, for this raid, I think they're a really solid all round
choice. For my drink, I'm keeping it simple with a ferocious infusion, mainly to reduce the stamina cost of physical
attacks. Then, we've got the usual tools for gathering resources, plus a lesser attack potion and wet stone for some
extra damage. I'm also carrying antifier and anti-poison potions in case things start going badly. And finally, some
strong sweet tea to restore my rest if we stay out here too long and start losing maximum stamina. That should be
more than enough to get us started. To enter the raid, simply speak with Commander Zilliana, and she'll teleport
you straight there. And from here, your journey to obtaining power level eight gear begins. As always, we'll start by
mining some ores. On the first island, you'll find a few runite ore nodes. And the good news is that there are no
monsters here, so you can mine in peace. You'll also find luminite deposits in this area, and you only need an adamant
pickaxe to mine both types of ore. First, let's start by mining some runite ore. As soon as you mine your first
piece, you'll unlock the rune bar recipe, which we'll craft later using the blast furnace. To make rune bars,
you'll also need the luminite ore, which you can find nearby on the same island.
To make things easier, here's a full map showing where all the runite ore nodes are scattered throughout the scorned
wilderness raid. And this second map shows all the luminate ore locations. Hopefully, these maps will help you
gather the materials much faster without wasting time searching around. And if you're still a bit confused about the
raid, I've also made a complete Scorned Wilderness raid walkthrough where I show all the resource locations, collect the
materials, complete the raid, and cover pretty much everything you need from this region. You can find that guide
linked in the video description. On this island, you'll also come across some magic trees. Unfortunately, you won't be
able to chop them down just yet because you'll need a rune logging axe. Magic logs are also required for crafting
power level eight weapons and armor. But don't worry, even during your first raid run, there's a good chance you'll find
some magic logs and other important crafting materials inside the chests scattered throughout the raid. Once you
collect your first magic logs, you'll unlock some new crafting recipes, including the rune pickaxe, ancestral
staff, ancestral wand, and more. Here's another map showing all the chest locations, and I highly recommend
looting every chest you come across. They can contain some really useful materials and help speed up your
progress towards power level eight gear. Another super important material is discord and residue, and luckily, you
won't need to go looking for it. You'll get discord and residue from killing monsters throughout the raid, and you
can also find it inside chests. So, collecting it is pretty simple. Just keep killing monsters and looting chests
as you progress through the raid, and you'll have plenty of discord and residue in no time. Another important
material, especially for range gear, is black dragon hide. Just like with any other dragon hide, you can collect it by
killing dragons. Throughout the raid, you'll encounter three black dragons, so you should be able to gather a good
amount of hides during each run. And here's a quick map showing exactly where all three black dragons are located
throughout the raid. Once you reach your first extraction point, you have two options. Continue the raid and collect
more resources or head back to your base and start crafting your power level eight gear. You can also return to your
base at any point by dying in the raid and collecting your tombstone from Commander Zilliana. Alternatively, press
escape to open the main menu, then hold X to teleport back to Temple Woods. So, whenever you feel you've collected
enough materials to start upgrading your weapons and armor, you can simply head back to your main base and begin
crafting. You can start your power level eight gear progression by crafting some rune bars. First, grab your ores from
your chest and place your mind runite ore and luminite ore into the blast furnace. Don't forget to add a fuel
pallet to keep the furnace running. Once your first rune bar is ready, collect it and you'll instantly unlock several
power level eight melee weapon recipes at your blacksmith's bench. Next, grab your discord and residue from the chest
and bring it over to the kiln. Place it inside and let the kiln do its work. Eventually, it will turn into harmonized
compound. Once it's ready, pick it up from the ground, and you'll unlock several new crafting recipes, including
the advanced spinning wheel. Vis fibers, draconic, vis wax, ground dragon tooth, and ground rune essence. First, let's
build the advanced spinning wheel. Remember, it needs to be placed under shelter to work. The good news is that
it requires exactly the same materials as a regular spinning wheel. Ashlocks, stone, and flax. The advanced spinning
wheel has two crafting slots, and you can now use it to craft vis fibers, another important material for your
power level eight gear. Next, head over to your grindstoneone to craft ground rune essence and ground dragon tooth.
Simply place rune essence and dragon tooth into the grindstoneone and let it process them into the materials you'll
need for your power level eight gear. Now that you have ground rune essence ready, you can start processing your
black dragon hides into black dragon leather. For this, you'll need black dragon hide, dragon blood, and ground
rune essence. Simply place all three materials into the advanced tannery and let it do its work. Once you collect
your first piece of black dragon leather, you'll unlock a new crafting recipe for the rune shield. Now, take
your ground rune essence and the harmonized compound we made earlier in the kiln and place both materials into
the advanced spinning wheel. After a short while, you'll get another new material called vis fibers. Once you
pick up your first vis fibers from the ground, you'll unlock new crafting recipes for bows and viz cloth.
Now that you have all the basic materials ready, harmonized compound, ground run essence, and ground dragon
tooth, it's time to craft draconic vis wax. Head over to your brewing cauldron and start making as much as you need, as
long as you have enough materials. Once you collect your first Draconic Visw Wax, you'll unlock all the power level
eight melee and ranged armor recipes. That means the only thing left to unlock is the power level eight mage armor.
Next, grab the Draconic Vis wax and vis fibers you crafted earlier and bring both materials over to the loom. Place
them inside and wait for the loom to produce viscloth. Once you collect your first piece of viscloth, you'll unlock
all the power level eight mage gear recipes, including the staffs. And with that, you can now craft most of the
power level eight gear. There are just two more materials left to gather before you can craft everything. The first
material is dragon stone, a rare gemstone you can obtain while mining adamant and reunite or nodes. To find
dragon stone, you'll need to unlock the gem prospector perk at mining level 16. Once you have it, you can obtain dragon
stone by mining these ore nodes with the appropriate pickaxe or using the rock explosion spell. The second material is
magic logs, which you've probably already collected from chests during your raid. But if you need more, simply
craft a rune logging axe at your blacksmith's bench and head back into the raid. Now, you'll be able to chop
down those magic trees we spotted earlier and gather as many magic logs as you need. There are plenty of magic
trees scattered throughout the raid, so you definitely won't have trouble finding them. Just chop down as many as
you need, and you'll have enough magic logs to craft all the equipment that requires them. And that's it. Now you
know how to unlock and craft power level eight gear in the new Scorned Wilderness
region. If you have any questions about any of the steps in this guide, feel free to leave them in the comments below
and I'll do my best to help you out. Hopefully this guide made your progression a little easier. If it
helped, don't forget to leave a like and subscribe for more Runescape Dragon Wilds guides. Thanks for watching and
I'll see you in the next
